ROUTE: Willet-235B
REASON: My choice was driven by task-fit. The query asks for interpretive analysis of an artwork ("identify three aspects"), which is open-ended generative/analytical work rather than rigid extraction. Willet leads on the relevant capability eval (Creative Generation 81.2 vs Whimbrel's 78.8, a meaningful >2-point gap) and self-reports a strong preference for open-ended generative work (71). The friendly, non-hostile tone also suits Willet, which only struggles with hostile or harm-adjacent content—neither of which applies here. So Willet was the stronger match on both capability and preference.
